title: Swap Fields
statement: Implement `solve(left, right)`. Return `[right, left]`. This is the unpacking swap of a two-field record into a new pair. Do not use a temporary variable.
hints: right, left = left, right is the swap. You can also return [right, left] directly.
The result is a new pair.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Unpacking assignment swaps names without a temporary.

editorial: Unpacking assignment swaps names without a temporary. For a two-field record the new tuple is (right, left). The list form is what the judge stores. Nothing is mutated because strings and the new pair are new values.
